components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main install and recovery action with a directional arrow.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:35px; min-height:54px; padding:16px 22px; border:1px solid var(--button-bg); border-radius:3px; background:var(--button-bg); color:var(--button-ink); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; transition:background .2s,color .2s; } .ds-button-primary span { transition:transform .4s var(--ease); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:var(--ink); color:var(--bg); border-color:var(--ink); } .ds-button-primary:hover span { transform:translateX(4px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:6px; }

components.name: Install Navigation Action
components.description: Compact bordered install route used in the shared header.
components.css: .ds-nav-install { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:25px; min-height:44px; padding:12px 18px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:3px; color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; transition:background .2s,color .2s; } .ds-nav-install:hover { background:var(--ink); color:var(--bg); } .ds-nav-install:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:6px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Underlined directional link used for secondary routes.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; transition:color .2s,border-color .2s; } .ds-text-link:hover { color:var(--accent); border-color:currentColor; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:6px; }

components.name: Operator Tab
components.description: Symbol-led language principle selector with an explicit selected state.
components.css: .ds-operator-tab { width:100%; min-height:90px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; padding:27px 0; border:0; border-block:1px solid var(--line); background:none; color:var(--muted); text-align:left; } .ds-operator-symbol { width:74px; flex:none; font-family:var(--font-code); font-size:43px; line-height:1; transition:transform .5s var(--ease); } .ds-operator-copy { font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:25px; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-operator-copy small { display:block; margin-top:8px; color:var(--muted); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:12px; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-operator-arrow { margin-left:auto; opacity:0; transform:translateX(-12px); transition:opacity .2s,transform .4s var(--ease); } .ds-operator-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color:var(--ink); } .ds-operator-tab[aria-selected="true"] .ds-operator-symbol { color:var(--accent-secondary); } .ds-operator-tab[aria-selected="true"] .ds-operator-arrow,.ds-operator-tab:hover .ds-operator-arrow { opacity:1; transform:none; } .ds-operator-tab:hover .ds-operator-symbol { transform:translateX(5px); } .ds-operator-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:6px; }

components.name: Code Panel
components.description: Theme-aware code surface with a compact copy action and semantic syntax.
components.css: .ds-code-panel { position:relative; overflow:hidden; border-radius:4px; background:var(--code-bg); color:var(--code-ink); } .ds-code-panel pre { margin:0; padding:55px 25px 30px; overflow:auto; color:inherit; font-family:var(--font-code); font-size:13px; line-height:1.85; } .ds-code-panel code span { color:var(--accent); } .ds-code-copy { position:absolute; top:8px; right:8px; width:36px; height:36px; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:8px; border:0; border-radius:3px; background:var(--code-bg); color:var(--muted); } .ds-code-copy:hover { color:var(--ink); background:var(--surface); } .ds-code-copy:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-code-copy:active { color:var(--accent); }

narrative.overview:
Styio turns its >> operator into substantial digital material. Monumental Syne typography, open composition, terse labels, and a liquid-chrome double-chevron sculpture make direction feel physical. Cool black and fog white establish the field; cobalt, cyan, fuchsia, and silver light carry action and flow.

The home page is vivid and kinetic. Documentation and error recovery use the same shell, typography, rules, and palette with a calmer reading rhythm. Content, navigation, and the hero artwork remain useful without animation or JavaScript.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized display type paired with exact body and monospace text.
Real language operators used as functional diagrams and graphic signatures.
Flat interface surfaces contrasted with one luminous, material hero object.
Fluid motion that stops with user preference, visibility, and viewport state.

rules.name: The Electric Signal Rule
rules.body: Use saturated color to identify action, flow, selection, syntax, and the signature artwork; let neutral fields preserve its impact.

rules.name: The Type Carries the Field Rule
rules.body: Let scale, line breaks, and operators form the composition around the single sculptural hero.

rules.name: The One Sculpture Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary surfaces flat and structural so the authored chrome operator remains the visual event.

dos: Do use real Styio operators as diagrams, signatures, and navigation cues.
Do preserve the shared shell, persistent theme choice, dynamic browser theme color, and readable static state.
Do use electric color to communicate action, selection, focus, syntax, flow, or reflected light.
Do keep documentation typography, code tools, installation steps, and recovery paths clear before adding expression.
donts: Don't restore the retired multi-family palette model behind the retained theme attribute names.
Don't add generic gradients, glossy cards, or decorative blobs to ordinary interface surfaces.
Don't animate hidden or offscreen work, run pose frames after settling, or make content depend on motion.
Don't create claims, telemetry, or user-data collection that the static product does not have.
